grammar.label: time linkers — as soon as, by the time, once, until
grammar.meaning: the precise relation between two events in time

explanation.en: 'As soon as' means immediately after; 'by the time' means before that moment; 'once' means after that point; 'until' means up to that point. None takes a future form after it.
explanation.uz: 'as soon as' — darhol keyin; 'by the time' — o'sha paytga qadar; 'once' — o'shandan keyin; 'until' — o'sha paytgacha. Hech biridan keyin kelasi zamon shakli kelmaydi.

grammar.positive_example: As soon as I hear, I will let you know.
grammar.negative_example: As soon as I will hear, I will let you know.

l1_notes.uz: Kelasi zamon ma'nosi bor, lekin shakl hozirgi zamon — bu qoida doim buziladi.

grammar.label: purpose clauses — so that, in order to, in case
grammar.form: so that + clause; in order to + verb; in case + clause
grammar.meaning: the reason you do something in advance

explanation.en: 'So that' and 'in order to' give a purpose. 'In case' gives a precaution against something that may happen: 'Take an umbrella in case it rains.'
explanation.uz: 'so that' va 'in order to' — maqsad. 'in case' — bo'lishi mumkin bo'lgan narsaga qarshi ehtiyot chorasi: 'Take an umbrella in case it rains.'

grammar.positive_example: I left early so that I would not be late.
grammar.negative_example: I left early in case to be late.

l1_notes.uz: 'in case' va 'if' aralashtiriladi: 'in case' oldindan chora, 'if' shart.
